10 Interior Designers in Chennai Whose Work You Need To Follow in 2026

SHARE

Looking to transform your space in Chennai and want some expert opinion? Check out our list of the top interior designers in the city. From home to office interior designers, you will certainly find the specialist that fits all your needs.

AUTHOR
Ruchika Verma
PUBLISHED ON
21 Aug 2024

SUMMARISE WITH:

ChatGPT Gemini Perplexity Claude

Chennai is a vibrant city with a penchant for multiculturalism. The city is known for its beautiful temples, beaches, culture, and metropolitan charm. Its unique blend of modern and traditional makes the city an exciting place to live at. As a metropolitan city with a thriving population of professionals, there is a high demand for interior designers who can transform living spaces for style and efficiency. 

We have curated a list of the top interior designers in Chennai who are masters of their art. So, let’s get into it!

Here is a brief view of our list of the best home and office interior designers in Chennai:

  1. Sheela Sri Prakash
  2. Venkat Krishnan
  3. K. Shivashankar & Priyadarshini Shivashankar
  4. Malli Saravanan & Kavitha Mohanraj
  5. Rachana Goyam & Vikram Goyam
  6. Deepal M.S.
  7. Sushmitha Ramesh
  8. Kishore Rajasekaran & Keerthika Surenthar
  9. Aishwarya Krish
  10. Sunita Yogesh

Top Interior Designers in Chennai

Each designer in our handpicked list knows how to combine client needs with their expertise to create homes out of houses and enjoyable working spaces from plots of land. We’ve also linked their Instagram handles for you to follow their extraordinary work. 

1. Sheela Sri Prakash

Image Source - Shilpa Architects

Sheela Sri Prakash is one of the most celebrated architects and interior designers in Chennai. She is renowned for being the first woman in India to have started and operated her own architectural practice, Shilpa Architects.

One of the leading names in the industry with more than 1200 projects under her name, Sheela draws inspiration from local arts, culture and heritage to create spaces that are effective and innovative. She is also a scholar with an extensive body of work exploring the impact of built environments on human behaviour. 

Sheela Sri Prakash has worked with the World Bank to design low-cost Reciprocal Housing for the underprivileged. She is also the brains behind the first-of-its-kind energy-efficient commercial building and custom bungalows. From public spaces to luxury hotels, she has undoubtedly proved her mettle as one of the best interior designers in Chennai, if not in India.

2. Venkat Krishnan

Image Source - Linkedin

Venkat Krishnan is the proud CEO of Vibrant Spaces, a multi-disciplinary practice with expertise in interior design, architecture and construction. He has been in the field for more than ten years with a record of completing 3000+ projects. Venkat is one of the top home interior designers in Chennai and his firm was awarded the “Best Interior Design and Build Company in Tamil Nade” in 2023 by FICCI.

A talented interior designer guided by the principles of quality and sustainable design, Venkat is known for infusing creativity with technicalities to create homes with exceptional style and utility. His firm was also an integral part of the “The Statue of Unity” project in Gujarat. It is fair to conclude that as far as home interior design in Chennai goes, Venkat Krishnan is one of the top choices.

3. K. Shivashankar & Priyadarshini Shivashankar

Image source - ED+ Architecture

K. Shivashankar & Priyadarshini Shivashankar are a dynamic duo who that founded the interior design firm, ED+ Architecture in 1988. They both have more than 30 years of experience designing commercial and residential spaces that resonate with the needs of their clients. They both have done their B.Arch from Manipal Institute of Technology and worked together on a number of luxury homes, hospitality, and commercial projects.

The duo’s focus on planning and preparation before exquisite execution has cemented them as one of the most celebrated luxury interior designers in Chennai. They have a prolific portfolio and have worked for clients like Landmark, Zolo, Park Hyatt, Tata Consultancy Services, Taj Hotels, Ascott, Reliance, Accenture, and many more!

4. Malli Saravanan & Kavitha Mohanraj

Image Source- Mawi Design

Co-founders of Mawi Design, Malli Saravanan & Kavitha Mohanraj, specialise in architectural, interior and landscape design. They design with the objective of humanising spaces and as a result, have executed some of the most stunning interior design plans for a variety of clients.

The process behind each of their projects is to foster the psycho-social well-being of humans residing or working within a physical space. They design with the intent of holistically amalgamating technical expertise with the aspirations of their clients. Both Malli and Kavitha are experienced professionals with a passion for creating spaces that people can connect with. With their unique approach to interior design, they are certainly one of the best to be found in Chennai.

5. Rachana Goyam & Vikram Goyam

Image Source - Surfaces Reporter

Rachana Goyam & Vikram Goyam are the power couple of luxury interior design in Chennai. They founded Midas Luxury Interiors in 2011 and since then, have completed more than 300 projects. They have worked extensively and their experience encompasses villas, offices, luxury showrooms, private landed residences, residential apartments, and more.

The Goyams work in a client-centric way and pride themselves on their problem-solving abilities. Their approach combines luxury with functionality to create a space that is soothing as well as practical. Their passion and dedication towards turning their client’s unique ideas into reality have certainly made them one of the top luxury interior designers in Chennai. 

6. Deepak Sundaram & Kavya Rajendra

Image Source - Linkedin

Deepak Sundaram & Kavya Rajendra are the proud co-founders of Studio One by Zero, an interior design firm located in Chennai. It is a fairly young company, founded in 2021, but has made a name for itself by integrating its distinctive style into the visions of its clients. They are environmentally conscious and source local materials in the most sustainable ways.

Deepak and Kavya bring a fresh perspective to every project they work on. From working only with bricks and cement to creating masterpieces using glass and panelling, this duo knows how to combine technical aspects of design with creativity. They are one of the most promising interior designers in Chennai to look out for! 

7. Sushmitha Ramesh 

Image Source - Linkedin

The Auburn Studio is the brainchild of Sushmitha Ramesh, a principal architect and interior designer. She had worked on a wide variety of hospitality projects in Colombo and Chennai before starting her firm. Sushmitha believes in designing experiences and this has led her to create some of the most detailed designs geared towards client satisfaction.

Sushmitha’s designs are focused on emphasizing the individuality of her clients and expressing their ‘multiple selves’ through the space they inhabit. She is a passionate designer with the ability to breathe life into every project she undertakes. An exemplary residential interior designer in Chennai, she is capable of transforming any place into a comfortable haven.

8. Kishore Rajasekaran & Keerthika Surenthar

Image Source - The Architects Diary

In their quest to create a truly holistic design experience, Kishore Rajasekaran & Keerthika Surenthar founded The Design Shop in 2014. Since then, they have become one of the leading interior designers in Chennai. They focus on simplifying the design process and creating an inclusive experience for their clients. From planning to construction, they sustainably plan each step of the process for maximum efficiency.

Kishore and Keerthika have worked on a number of projects showcasing their expertise and skills. Their commitment towards clients and art is truly admirable. They enjoy designing as well as executing, which makes them the perfect pair of professionals to take over your next renovation project! 

9. Aishwarya Krish

Image Source - Linkedin

Aishwarya Krish is an emerging name in the interior design industry. Her venture Roaish Architecture + Design is her attempt at building an ecosystem which facilitates the creation of spaces that are comfortable and stylish. Her design philosophy is guided by offering her clients a space that brings joy to their lives. Over the last three years, she has worked on more than 55 projects and has brought her unique expertise to each.

She is a detail-oriented interior designer in Chennai with a penchant for adding a touch of her personality and warmth to every project she works on. She enjoys little things in life and this is reflected in her work as well. Aishwarya ensures her client’s needs materialise in the best way possible, and it is certainly one of her best qualities! 

10. Sunita Yogesh

Image Source - Good Homes

Sunita Yogesh Studio by Sunita Yogesh offers comprehensive interior design services in Chennai. Known for adding an urban touch to her projects, Sunita is always open to challenging her ever-evolving style. As an adaptable interior designer, she has worked with a wide range of clients and showcased her expertise by incorporating an eclectic style into each of them.

From small residential apartments to modern office interior design, Sunita can adapt her style to the needs of her clients. She is known for offering a unique perspective and adding a special touch to each of her projects. From earthy textures to bright white lights, she is a versatile designer with a myriad of ideas to transform your space completely!

A Guide to Becoming an Interior Designer in Chennai

If you are feeling inspired to pursue a career in interior designer after going through this list, we totally understand! 

Interior design is a stimulating field that combines art with science to produce a material impact on the lives of people. So, if you are looking to start your journey, read on for some tips on how to begin.

1. Pursue Education - Interior design is a lot more complicated than it seems. While some may have a natural propensity for it, a formal education is the best way to give your interest the right direction. Pursuing an online interior design course will not only offer you valuable knowledge but will also help you gain credibility in the eyes of the clients.

2. Develop Your Skills - Interior design is a dynamic field with ever-evolving trends. You need to consistently be on your feet and keep abreast of the newest styles. Keep updating yourself and developing your skills to be on top of your game and be a good interior designer.

3. Create Your Resume & Build a Portfolio - Your portfolio represents you as a designer and your resume represents you as a professional. Ensure you are creating both with utmost care and precision. Your portfolio is especially important as it will represent your style and design process to the clients. You can check out this Residential Project by AND Learner Jaladhi Shah to get inspiration for your next project!

4. Do an Internship - To gain expertise in a field, there is no better way than to get real-life work experience. Doing an internship will help you gain valuable knowledge and insights into the industry. Not only does it add to your resume, but also to the overall quality of your work. Doing an internship is a great entry point to the industry.

5. Get Out in the World - Once you have some experience and a portfolio under your name, the world is your oyster. Choose a niche and work with a firm or build your own. There is a lot of variety and opportunities for experimentation in this field. All you need to do is get out there and explore as much as you can! 

Next Steps

Interior design is exciting but it is not an easy field to succeed in. One needs dedication and perseverance to excel and make a name for themselves. We hope this list of top interior designers in Chennai inspires you to get started on the path to your goals! 

In case you need further assistance, here are some resources to consider:

  1. Watch this session by Snehanshu Mukherjee, Founding Partner at T.E.A.M and Mansi Almadi, an Interior Designer at Studio Lotus
  2. Talk to a course advisor to discuss how you can transform your career with one of our courses.
  3. Check out our Interior Design courses - all courses are taught through live, interactive classes by industry experts.
  4. Take advantage of our scholarship and funding options to overcome any financial hurdle on the path of your career transformation.

Note: All information and/or data from external sources is believed to be accurate as of the date of publication.
